blocks.text: Coco Martin believes Filipino films could gain greater recognition on the international stage if the government equips the local film industry with proper support. Martin made the remarks during an interview with select members of the press at Ihaw Fest 2026, where he discussed the success of his series “Sigabo” and his desire to highlight Filipino culture and values through his work. “Kung nasusuportahan lang tayo ng tama ng gobyerno natin, maipagmamalaki natin ang buong Pilipinas,” he said.
